title: Fake skill to sync animation with damage.

posts.author: PrototypeZer0_
posts.body:
I was reading the source code of a game to learn how it manages to create an animation and deal the damage at same time. A fake skill is created with common events, it puts the pictures and effects and then makes a force skill with a real skill that has the real damage.
But my question is if this is the only way to do it. Because this is a workaround in VX Ace and I'm using RPG Maker MZ. Isn't there a newer or easier way to do it that doesn't involve hardcoding?

posts.author: Andar

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
There's no such thing as an attack frame, so I'm assuming you're referring to the show picture command you seem to be using for some reason.. In your other thread it has also already been suggested to use action sequencing.
Use an actual sideview battler instead of what looks like show picture commands, so you can utilize the motions on them to your needs via action sequencing, which also lets you time whenever the actual dmg pops up.
